title: Bound along a bounded walk
statement: Let $R$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers and let $K,j,c,t$ be natural numbers. If $c<K$ and there is an $R$-walk from $c$ to $t$ of length at most $j$ whose vertices are bounded by $K$, then $t<K$.
hypotheses_covered: there is a walk of length at most $j$ from $c$ to $t$ under the relation $R$, with intermediate vertices less than $K$
